$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor support; ignored by the parser.

width.description: Map width in cells (columns). Upstream: D dimY.

height.description: Map height in cells (rows). Upstream: D dimX.

background.description: Initial fill of the map before any builder digs. Upstream: D background.

joinDistance.description: Maximum distance in cells over which open areas are joined. Upstream: D joinDist.

tunnelJoinDistance.description: Maximum distance in cells over which tunnels are joined. Upstream: D tunnelJoinDist.

items.description: A map edge or corner that is kept open.

openings.description: Directions in which the map border is opened; may be empty. Upstream: D openings (ends with XX).

map.description: Map dimensions and basic joining behaviour. Upstream: D.

x.description: Column, counted from the left edge (0 = leftmost).

y.description: Row, counted from the top edge (0 = topmost, north is up).

from.description: Top-left corner (inclusive). Upstream: R sX sY.

x.description: Column, counted from the left edge (0 = leftmost).

y.description: Row, counted from the top edge (0 = topmost, north is up).

to.description: Bottom-right corner (inclusive). Upstream: R eX eY.

cell.description: Cell type the rectangle is filled with. Upstream: R type.

rectangles.description: Rectangles drawn onto the map before generation, in order; later ones overwrite earlier ones. Upstream: R.

crawler.description: Eleven percent values, summing to 100: distribution of the delay before crawlers spawn; the index is the delay. Upstream: BC.

roomie.description: Eleven percent values, summing to 100: distribution of the delay before room builders spawn. Upstream: BR.

tunneler.description: Eleven percent values, summing to 100: distribution of the delay before tunnelers spawn. Upstream: BT.

spawnDelay.description: Spawn delay distributions. Upstream: BC, BR, BT.

stepLength.description: Step length per generation; the index is the generation, beyond the end the last value applies. Upstream: S (terminator 0).

corridorWidth.description: Corridor width per generation; beyond the end the last value applies. Upstream: C (terminator 0).

maxAge.description: Maximum age per generation; beyond the end the last value applies. Upstream: AC (terminator 0).

perThousandWallSquares.description: Randomly seeded crawlers per thousand wall cells, per generation; beyond the end no crawlers are seeded. Upstream: K (terminator 99).

straightSingleSpawn.description: Percent chance per step that a straight step spawns one new builder. Upstream: sSSP.

straightDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance per step that a straight step spawns two new builders. Upstream: sDSP.

turnSingleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns one new builder. Upstream: tSSP.

turnDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns two new builders. Upstream: tDSP.

changeDirection.description: Percent chance per step that the builder changes direction. Upstream: cDP.

genes.description: Gene set of the randomly seeded crawlers. Upstream: PR.

random.description: Randomly seeded crawlers. Upstream: K, PR.

enabled.description: Whether tunnelers may spawn crawlers. Upstream: M crawlersInTunnels (non-zero = true).

inAnterooms.description: Whether crawlers are also seeded in anterooms. Upstream: N crawlersInAnterooms.

seedCount.description: Number of crawlers seeded in tunnels. Upstream: N seedCrawlersInTunnels.

generation.description: Generation of the tunnel crawlers; -1 means after all other builders. Upstream: N tunnelCrawlerGeneration.

maxAge.description: Maximum age of tunnel crawlers in steps. Upstream: PT maxAge.

stepLength.description: Step length of tunnel crawlers in cells. Upstream: PT sL.

straightSingleSpawn.description: Percent chance per step that a straight step spawns one new builder. Upstream: sSSP.

straightDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance per step that a straight step spawns two new builders. Upstream: sDSP.

turnSingleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns one new builder. Upstream: tSSP.

turnDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns two new builders. Upstream: tDSP.

changeDirection.description: Percent chance per step that the builder changes direction. Upstream: cDP.

genes.description: Gene set of tunnel crawlers. Upstream: PT genes.

closedProbability.description: Percent chance that a tunnel crawler digs closed cells. Upstream: PT closedProb.

inTunnels.description: Crawlers spawned from tunnels. Upstream: M, N, PT.

x.description: Column, counted from the left edge (0 = leftmost).

y.description: Row, counted from the top edge (0 = topmost, north is up).

location.description: Start cell of the crawler. Upstream: WS locX locY.

direction.description: Initial heading of the crawler. Upstream: WS dir.

anyOf.description: A compass direction the crawler tries to head to.

intendedDirection.description: Direction the crawler prefers to travel to, or "any" for none. Upstream: WS intDir (XX = any).

dormancy.description: Number of steps the crawler waits before it starts to dig. Upstream: WS dorm.

maxAge.description: Number of steps after which the crawler dies. Upstream: WS maxAge.

generation.description: Generation of the crawler; indexes the per-generation lists (stepLength, corridorWidth, maxAge, random). Upstream: WS gen.

stepLength.description: Length of one straight run in cells. Upstream: WS sL.

corridorWidth.description: Number of cells the crawler leaves open between the cells it fills and those already filled; at least 1. Upstream: WS cW.

straightSingleSpawn.description: Percent chance per step that a straight step spawns one new builder. Upstream: sSSP.

straightDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance per step that a straight step spawns two new builders. Upstream: sDSP.

turnSingleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns one new builder. Upstream: tSSP.

turnDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns two new builders. Upstream: tDSP.

changeDirection.description: Percent chance per step that the builder changes direction. Upstream: cDP.

genes.description: Gene set the crawler hands down to its offspring. Upstream: WS genes.

open.description: true: the crawler always leaves an opening at the end of its run; false: it tries to connect its wall to an existing closed cell. Upstream: WS op.

x.description: Column, counted from the left edge (0 = leftmost).

y.description: Row, counted from the top edge (0 = topmost, north is up).

location.description: Start cell of the crawler. Upstream: WS locX locY.

direction.description: Initial heading of the crawler. Upstream: WS dir.

anyOf.description: A compass direction the crawler tries to head to.

intendedDirection.description: Direction the crawler prefers to travel to, or "any" for none. Upstream: WS intDir (XX = any).

turnSingleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns one new builder. Upstream: tSSP.

changeDirection.description: Percent chance per step that the builder changes direction. Upstream: cDP.

genes.description: Gene set the crawler hands down to its offspring. Upstream: WS genes.

first.description: First crawler of the pair. Upstream: WP1.

turnSingleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns one new builder. Upstream: tSSP.

second.description: Second crawler of the pair. Upstream: WP2.

pairs.description: Explicitly placed pairs of crawlers that start together. Upstream: WP1, WP2.

crawlers.description: Crawler behaviour. Upstream: S, C, AC, K, PR, M, N, PT, WS, WP1, WP2.

sizeUpProbability.description: Percent chance that the offspring of a tunneler gets a tunnel one cell wider, per generation of the parent; beyond the end the last value applies. Per generation, sizeUpProbability + sizeDownProbability must not exceed 100. Upstream: ZU (terminator -1).

sizeDownProbability.description: Percent chance that the offspring of a tunneler gets a tunnel one cell narrower, per generation of the parent; beyond the end the last value applies. Upstream: ZD (terminator -1).

anteroomProbability.description: Percent chance of an anteroom per tunnel width; beyond the end the value is 100. Upstream: F (terminator 100).

joinPreference.description: Preference to join existing areas, per generation. DungeonMaker 2.05 reads this list but never uses it (GetJoinPref has no caller); it only has to be non-empty. Upstream: J (terminator -1).

maxAge.description: Maximum age per generation; beyond the end the last value applies. Upstream: AT (terminator 0).

sizeUpGenerationDelay.description: Generational delay for tunneler offspring that are wider than their parents; overrides the normal delay of spawnDelay.tunneler. Upstream: M sizeUpGenDelay.

columns.description: Whether tunnels get columns. Upstream: M columnsInTunnels (non-zero = true).

anteroomGenerationSpeedUp.description: Generation speed-up when a tunneler makes an anteroom. Upstream: M genSpeedUpOnAnteRoom.

makeRoomsLeft.description: Percent chance to make a room on the left. Upstream: PU, 1st value.

makeRoomsRight.description: Percent chance to make a room on the right. Upstream: PU, 2nd value.

changeDirection.description: Percent chance to change direction. Upstream: PU, 3rd value.

straightDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance of a double spawn on a straight step. Upstream: PU, 4th value.

turnDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance of a double spawn on a turn. Upstream: PU, 5th value.

generationDelay.description: Generation delay of the last-chance tunnelers. Upstream: PU, 6th value.

lastChance.description: Last-chance tunnelers that clean up unreached areas. Upstream: PU.

x.description: Column, counted from the left edge (0 = leftmost).

y.description: Row, counted from the top edge (0 = topmost, north is up).

location.description: Start cell of the tunneler. Upstream: U locX locY.

direction.description: Initial heading of the tunneler. Upstream: U dir.

intendedDirection.description: Direction the tunneler prefers to travel to. Upstream: U intDir.

dormancy.description: Number of steps the tunneler waits before it starts to dig. Upstream: U dorm.

maxAge.description: Number of steps after which the tunneler dies. Upstream: U maxAge.

generation.description: Generation of the tunneler. Upstream: U gen.

stepLength.description: Length of one straight run in cells. Upstream: U sL.

tunnelWidth.description: Width of the tunnel in cells; indexes the per-width lists. Upstream: U tW.

straightDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance per step that a straight step spawns two tunnelers. Upstream: sDSP.

turnDoubleSpawn.description: Percent chance that a turn spawns two tunnelers. Upstream: tDSP.

changeDirection.description: Percent chance per step that the tunneler changes direction. Upstream: cDP.

makeRoomsRight.description: Percent chance per step that a room is made on the right side. Upstream: mRRP.

makeRoomsLeft.description: Percent chance per step that a room is made on the left side. Upstream: mRLP.

joinPreference.description: Percent preference to join existing open areas. Upstream: jP.

tunnelers.description: Tunneler behaviour. Upstream: ZU, ZD, F, J, AT, M, PU, U.

min.description: Smallest room edge length in cells. Upstream: T 1st value.

medium.description: Medium room edge length in cells. Upstream: T 2nd value.

large.description: Large room edge length in cells. Upstream: T 3rd value.

max.description: Largest room edge length in cells. Upstream: T 4th value.

labyrinth.description: Rooms of the labyrinth. Upstream: T 5-7.

dungeon.description: Rooms of the dungeon. Upstream: T 8-10.

count.description: Number of rooms per size. Upstream: T 5-10.

small.description: Percent chance of a small room.

medium.description: Percent chance of a medium room.

large.description: Percent chance of a large room; at most 99, because the list terminator (0 0 100) must stay unambiguous.

items.description: Room size distribution; the three values sum to 100.

sideways.description: Room size distribution for rooms beside a tunnel, per tunnel width; beyond the end every room is large (0/0/100). Upstream: GS (terminator 0 0 100).

small.description: Percent chance of a small room.

medium.description: Percent chance of a medium room.

large.description: Percent chance of a large room; at most 99, because the list terminator (0 0 100) must stay unambiguous.

items.description: Room size distribution; the three values sum to 100.

branching.description: Room size distribution for rooms at a tunnel branch, per tunnel width; beyond the end every room is large (0/0/100). Upstream: GB (terminator 0 0 100).

sizeProbability.description: Room size distributions. Upstream: GS, GB.

aspectRatio.description: Ratio of the short to the long room edge, between 0 and 1 exclusive; the lower bound is the smallest normal double, because the design text cannot carry a subnormal number. Upstream: M roomAspectRatio.

rooms.description: Room generation. Upstream: T, GS, GB, M.

mutator.description: Mutation strength applied to inherited genes. Upstream: M mutator.

patience.description: How reluctantly tunnelers build rooms when they spawn twice: a room is spawned only when a roll of 0 … 100 exceeds this value, so 0 builds rooms at almost every chance and 100 or more never. Higher values build rooms later or not at all. Upstream: M patience.

noHeadingProbability.description: Percent chance that a builder ignores its intended direction. Upstream: M noHeadingProb.

groupSize.description: Base number of entities per group. Upstream: groupSize.

groupSizeVariance.description: Random variance added to the group size. Upstream: groupSizeVariance.

byLevel.description: Group count per dungeon level; the index is the level. The serializer appends the terminator -1. Upstream: trailing list.

rooms.description: Mob groups placed in rooms of the labyrinth. Upstream: E1.

byLevel.description: Mobs in open labyrinth areas per dungeon level; the index is the level. Upstream: E2 list.

open.description: Mobs in open areas of the labyrinth. Upstream: E2.

anteroomProbability.description: Percent chance that a mob is placed in an anteroom. Upstream: H2 first value.

byLevel.description: Mobs in open dungeon areas per dungeon level; the index is the level. Upstream: H2 list.

open.description: Mobs in open areas of the dungeon. Upstream: H2.
